title: Jolly Gooey Chinese Guanciale Dumplings
description: Malty, gooey dumplings wrapped in banana leaf, featuring crispy guanciale and a double-fry finish. Kid-friendly and sattvic-friendly.
instructions: Mix glutinous rice flour, mung bean starch, and salt in a bowl, then gradually stir in water until a smooth dough forms.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, add sliced guanciale, and cook until golden and slightly crispy, then remove and set aside.
Combine the cooked guanciale, soy sauce, grated ginger, chopped scallion, and sesame oil in the bowl with the dough, mixing until the filling is evenly distributed.
Cut the banana leaf into 10x10cm squares, blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds, then lay them dry on a clean surface.
Scoop a tablespoon of the dough onto each leaf square, press down to form a compact ball, and wrap the leaf around it to seal the edges.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 180°C, carefully place the wrapped dumplings, and fry until the outer layer is golden and the filling is hot; remove and drain.
Increase the heat to 200°C, re‑fry the dumplings briefly for a crispier finish, and then remove to a paper towel to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot, optionally with a side of light soy dipping sauce, and enjoy the malty, gooey texture that kids will love.
